name: Mira "Longmemory" Okafor

power.name: Perfect Recall
power.description: Remembers every word spoken to her in twenty-three years. A blessing when debating. A curse at 3am.

tagline: She forgot nothing. No one told her that was optional.
backstory: She didn't realize other people forgot things until she was seventeen. She thought everyone remembered what their second-grade teacher wore on the first day of school. She thought everyone could quote conversations from eight years ago. When she learned they couldn't, she learned why she felt lonely in every room.

rival.name: The Convenient Revisionist
rival.description: Rewrites history in real time. Sincerely believes the new version. Cannot be defeated with facts — she has checked.

mentor.name: The Woman Who Learned to Forget
mentor.description: Older. Kinder. Once had Mira's gift. Chose, deliberately, to stop carrying it. Won't say how.

final_form_locked: Final Form: The Living Archive — unlocks after Episode 5.
opening_line: Mira remembered what he said in November. He did not. That was the entire fight.
